task: research/buildbot-sheathing milestone 55: held-or-free margin covering the sensor error

doc_friction.issue: Calling milestone 53's plan four times per case to read the settle map made a 2-load smoke run take 701 s (projected over 3 h for the full run); a replica of the plan loop with linear settles, checked against plan to 0.0 N m, cut it to 187 s. Later milestones in this chain should expose the planned contact forces instead of only torques.
A python job that prints only at the end gives no progress; the 36-minute run needed four 10-minute waits. Not wrong, just slow to watch.

deviations.why: The registered model said to search every hold-side combination when the pose's sides fail; the run skips the search when every joint below the margin is above the legs (waist, arms), since hold sides move only leg torques and the squeeze has zero net wrench.
deviations.did: Skipped the side search for non-leg failures, stated in the code and LOG; justified by the physics and by 25 of 25 such cases in the smoke run and 125 of 125 searched cases in the full run having 0 passing combinations.
deviations.result: Run time fell to 36 min; the coverage numbers could only rise if a skipped case had a passing combination, which the argument rules out.

notes: Routed to research (weighted draw), drew track 20 -> buildbot-sheathing. Registered H220-H222 and opened draft PR #17491 before computing.
